What the photograph records

Dentons Catering Equipment at 2-4 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7UT, photographed on 3 April 2026 while still trading. Relocation-sale posters fill the display windows beneath its pale shop sign.

This record describes the premises on the photograph date. Later changes may not yet be included in the archive.

A few dates in the story

  1. 3 April 2026 Documented

    Dentons Catering Equipment photographed here

    Dentons Catering Equipment at 2-4 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7UT, photographed on 3 April 2026 while still trading. Relocation-sale posters fill the display windows beneath its pale shop sign. This documents the business on the photograph date, not its opening date.

  2. 1 May 2026 Published source

    Dentons: Clapham shop closes

    Dentons announced that its Clapham High Street shop closed on Friday 1 May 2026 after 90 years on the street. The business continued from new premises in South Wimbledon, without a public-facing shop.
